title: Condition 实现有界缓冲的生产者消费者
expected_output:
生产: 12 | 消费: 12
数量守恒: True
顺序一致（FIFO）: True
缓冲区已清空: True
code:
import threading
from collections import deque


# Condition 是「锁 + 等待队列」的组合：经典的生产者/消费者。
# 关键细节：等待必须写在 while 里（防虚假唤醒 / 条件被别的线程改掉）。

CAP = 3
TOTAL = 12
buf = deque()
cv = threading.Condition()
produced = []
consumed = []


def producer():
    for i in range(TOTAL):
        with cv:
            while len(buf) >= CAP:       # while 而非 if
                cv.wait()
            buf.append(i)
            produced.append(i)
            cv.notify_all()              # 条件变了，唤醒等待者


def consumer():
    while True:
        with cv:
            while not buf and len(consumed) < TOTAL:
                cv.wait()
            if not buf:
                cv.notify_all()
                return
            consumed.append(buf.popleft())
            cv.notify_all()


p = threading.Thread(target=producer)
cs = [threading.Thread(target=consumer) for _ in range(2)]
p.start()
for c in cs:
    c.start()
p.join()
for c in cs:
    c.join()

print("生产:", len(produced), "| 消费:", len(consumed))
print("数量守恒:", len(produced) == len(consumed) == TOTAL)
print("顺序一致（FIFO）:", consumed == list(range(TOTAL)))
print("缓冲区已清空:", len(buf) == 0)
